text: Sharon Rozas () is a supporting character in Xenosaga: Pied Piper. She is a doctor that helps out Jan Sauer and eventually marries him. Her son is Joaquin Rozas.
Sergius XIV is a minor antagonist in Xenosaga: Pied Piper. He is a former cardinal of the Immigrant Fleet who ascends to becoming the Patriarch during the events of the game.
Shigeyoshi Inoue is a minor character from Xenogears. He is unnamed in the game, while his full name is revealed in Perfect Works.
Shelley Godwin () is a supporting character in the Xenosaga series. She is an aide to Gaignun and also assists Jr.. She is the elder sister of Mary Godwin.

Sigmund is a character in Xenogears. He is Kaiser of the nation of Kislev.

Stratski is an antagonist in Xenogears. He is a member of the Gebler Special Forces soldiers assigned under Elly that repeatedly fight against the party during the game. Stratski pilots the Swordknight.
Suou Uzuki () is a supporting character in the Xenosaga series. He is the father of Shion Uzuki and Jin Uzuki.
Tolone is a character of Xenogears. She is one of the Elements representing the Wind element. She is often paired with Seraphita.
Timothy (, Timothy) is a tertiary character from Xenogears. He is the best friend of Fei during his time in Lahan Village.
Tony () is a supporting character in the Xenosaga series. He is the pilot of the Elsa.

Vance is an antagonist in Xenogears. He is a member of the Gebler Special Forces soldiers assigned under Elly that repeatedly fight against the party during the game. Vance pilots the Clawknight.
Vanderkaum is an antagonist in Xenogears. He was originally the leader of Gebler until Ramsus and the Elements took control, demoting him in the process.
Wilhelm () is a supporting character in the Xenosaga series. He is the mysterious founder and CEO of Vector Industries, making him Shion's, Allen's and Miyuki's employer.
Wiseman is a character in Xenogears. He is a mysterious masked man who follows Fei and his group and is an opponent in the Aveh Battle Tournament. He seems to know Khan Wong.

Moren Highmountain was a chieftain of the Highmountain Tribe and wielder of the Eagle Spear who lived several generations prior to the War of the Ancients. He once saved the Wild God Ohn'ahra from an attack by fire elementals, and in gratitude, the eagle spirit infused a portion of her essence into Moren's spear, gifting it with powerful magical abilities. Moren, in turn, carved Ohn'ahra's name onto the haft of the weapon, which his people took to calling "the Eagle Spear" in her honor. To commemorate other heroes he encountered, enemies he bested, and events he witnessed, Moren carved their names onto the Eagle Spear as well. Power Word: Shield (abbreviated PW:S) is a defensive Power Word priests learn at level 4. It creates a protective shield around a friendly target which absorbs a set amount of damage, and prevents spell pushback. Power Word: Shield is undoubtedly one of the signature spells of the Discipline priest, protecting the target with a powerful shield that can seem unbreakable. It also is one of the primary ways Discipline priests apply Atonement to their allies.

A standard ability (or power) for classes that can use ranged weapons to fire the weapon. Hunters do not have this ability. They have Auto Shot instead. Shooting in WoW is not that much different from other MMORPG games. A player with the ability to shoot in most cases moves to maximum range and then fires his ranged weapon. Shooting is very useful for finishing off an opponent or dealing damage while avoiding the same. Some classes, most notably, the Hunter, depend heavily on ranged weapons and dealing damage from afar with the same.

Enchanting is a primary profession in which characters use magical formulas to grant permanent augmentation to armor, weapons, and other items. Enchanting recipes require the use of special Enchanting ingredients which can be gathered by disenchanting items of uncommon or better quality or found as loot. Using these ingredients enchanters can make items more powerful by adding a statistic bonus like strength or intellect or many other options. See Enchantments by slot for a list of enchantments and their benefits. Blood Elves have Arcane Affinity, which provides a bonus of +10 to their Enchanting skill.

Felstorm Point was an area on the northern edge of the Blade's Edge Mountains, north of Gruul's Lair. It was full of demons of the Burning Legion. To the east was the Crystal Spine, where the terrain turned into rocky crystals occupied by flying netherdrakes, and to the west was a group of Ethereum ethereals at a place they called Bash'ir Landing. Felstorm Point was only reachable by flight. It was removed from the game with patch 2.1.0 (Black Temple) to clear a place for questing in the nearby Bash'ir Landing, Insidion's Perch, and Furywing's Perch.

The Fellovar was a high elven merchant ship captained by Revenn during the Third War. Fire Shield places a damage shield on the Warlock and any party members within range (30 yards). The shield deals Fire damage to any enemy who hits a protected person. In addition, rank 6 and higher also increase the Fire resistance. Fire Shield has a spell power coefficient of roughly 1% of the imp's spell power or 0.15% of the warlock's spell power.

It is only accessible by flight. Forge Camp Wrath and Terror are equipped with several emplacements of fel flak cannons to shoot down any Sha'tari Skyguard fliers or other enemies — such as, perhaps, the black dragonflight — that might attack from the air. Rate of Fire is the frequency at which a specific weapon can fire its projectiles, or magic attack for wands. This correlates to ranged attack speed. Rate of fire directly affects the speed of attack for weapons for which the character has the autoshot ability (mages, priests, and warlocks with wands, and hunters with bows, crossbows, or guns).
